title: Unfriendly partitions
exact_target: Can every countable graph be divided into two parts so that every vertex has at least as many neighbors across the division as on its own side?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 3303 (OPG-687). CC BY 4.0.
